description: List the immediate child outcome groups under one outcome group (outcome_group_id) — one level of the tree, not a recursive walk. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Call this again with each returned group's id to descend further, or use list_outcome_group_outcomes on the same outcome_group_id to list outcomes linked directly under it instead of its child groups.

context_id.description: The Canvas account ID or course ID for the context.

name: list_outcome_group_subgroups
title: List Outcome Group Subgroups
